decision_conditions: <p>The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.</p>

<p>The roof of the ground floor extension hereby approved shall not be used as a terrace, balcony, or similar amenity area.</p><p><br></p><p>REASON: In the interests of neighbouring amenities.&nbsp;</p>

All new external facing and roofing materials in respect of all the works hereby approved (and any other incidental works carried out in this connection) shall match those of the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance including type, size, colour, bond, pointing, coursing, jointing, profile and texture (delete as appropriate)


REASON: To preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the conservation area.

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The unlawful development relating to the rear dormer extension (Ref:2024/0159/ENF (Works to roof extension and rear elevation not in accordance with pp ref: 2023/1318)), must be modified and made right within 12 months of determination of this planning permission. The proposed development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-6e621c5d-7fff-c9f4-8032-4d0ee1f140b2"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.38;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended)</span><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#500050;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:italic;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">.</span></p>

<p><span id="m_-3072944379393022013m_-1804796576080283675m_-4245048912011741604m_-3028693478052706773m_1813983110517026657m_-3546207259524996920m_4391726321936990267gmail-docs-internal-guid-47fc7a37-7fff-a0a0-6eae-81131bdf9fca"><span style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small;">Prior to the commencement of the proposed works, detailed drawings and full specifications of the proposed green/biodiverse roof shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The submission shall include cross-sectional drawings (scale 1:20) confirming a minimum substrate depth of 80mm (for a Sedum Roof) or 100mm-150mm (for a biodiverse/wildflower roof), excluding the vegetative mat; a planting plan incorporating a diverse mix of species containing a minimum of 25 species for a roof this size, including native species beneficial to local wildlife; and a management and maintenance plan to ensure the long-term success of the green roof. The approved details shall be fully implemented and retained thereafter.</span><br></span></p><p><span id="m_-3072944379393022013m_-1804796576080283675m_-4245048912011741604m_-3028693478052706773m_1813983110517026657m_-3546207259524996920m_4391726321936990267gmail-docs-internal-guid-47fc7a37-7fff-a0a0-6eae-81131bdf9fca">REASON: To protect and enhance biodiversity</span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5pt;">.</span></p>
